resources.string: Make meyouww work like WhatsApp when it\'s closed.
This phone will stop getting notifications until you sign in again.
When meyouww is closed, messages and wallpapers still arrive within seconds, as long as these are set up. It takes about a minute.
Push is set up in this build
This build has no Firebase settings, so nothing can arrive while the app is closed. Install a build made with the settings in docs/SETUP.md.
Notifications are off for meyouww or for an important category. Every remote change is announced, so they must be on.
Android lets meyouww run when needed.
Battery use is set to \"Restricted\", which blocks background work. Open App info → Battery and choose \"Unrestricted\" or \"Optimised\".
Downloads can run on mobile data.
Data Saver blocks background downloads. Allow unrestricted data for meyouww.
%1$s phones can stop apps after you swipe them away. Allow meyouww once, then confirm below.
Google Play services is missing or needs an update. Without it, nothing can arrive while meyouww is closed.
Alarms and reminders can ring on time.
Without this, alarms and reminders may ring a few minutes late. It doesn\'t affect messages.
Settings → Apps → Manage apps → meyouww → turn on Autostart. Then Battery saver → No restrictions.
Settings → Apps → App management → meyouww → Battery usage → allow background activity and auto launch.
Settings → Battery → Background power consumption management → meyouww → Allow. Also allow Autostart in i Manager.
Settings → Battery → App launch → meyouww → Manage manually, and turn on all three switches.
Settings → Battery → Background usage limits → make sure meyouww is not in Sleeping or Deep sleeping apps.
Phone Master → App management → Auto-start → allow meyouww. Also set Battery to No restrictions.
Open App info → Battery and allow background activity. dontkillmyapp.com has steps for your exact phone.
Tap the button, then swipe meyouww away from your recent apps and lock your phone. A test arrives in about 20 seconds.
Asking the server to send a test
Test on its way. Swipe meyouww away and lock your phone now.
The test hasn\'t arrived yet. Check the items marked ✗ or ? above, then try again.
Allow notifications first. The test shows up as a notification.

Like WhatsApp, meyouww can\'t receive anything after you use \"Force stop\" (until you open it again), while your phone is off or offline, or on phones without Google Play services. Accepted alarms still ring offline.

A picture from a friend would replace it, and meyouww can\'t bring a live wallpaper back.
My lock screen rotates its own pictures
Some phone makers\' lock screens may cover a lock-screen wallpaper.
Share my phone\'s maker and model
